sections.Profile:
"Rack 'Em Up" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1983. The game has a pool and billiards theme, featuring two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball. It is part of the Gottlieb System 80A series, with artwork by David Moore and sound by Craig Beierwaltes. A total of 1,762 units were produced.
